::: {.callout-note}
## This is a preview of the new site
Methods in Microbiomics is moving to this new format one lesson at a time. The current site, with all protocols, is still at [methods-in-microbiomics.readthedocs.io](https://methods-in-microbiomics.readthedocs.io/).
:::

Lessons and best practices for robust, reproducible analysis of microbiome sequencing data, written by people who use these methods daily in the [Sunagawa group](https://micro.biol.ethz.ch/research/sunagawa.html) and the NCCR Microbiomes.

Every lesson is something you **do**, not just read:

- **Command-line steps** run in a ready-made cloud computer (GitHub Codespaces). The tools and data are already installed, so there's nothing to set up on your laptop.
- **Analysis steps** run in R **directly in this page**. Edit the code, run it, and check yourself with exercises.
- Each lesson ends with what changes when you go from the teaching data to a real project.

New here? Read [how this site works](how-it-works.qmd) first.

## Learning paths

:::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .path-card}
### I have shotgun metagenomes
**Gene catalogs: build, quantify, analyse.** Find the genes in your samples, measure how abundant they are per cell, and relate them to the environment.

[Complete]{.status-badge .status-complete}

[About 3 hours · Codespace + browser · needs a GitHub account]{.card-facts}

[Start the lesson →](lessons/gene-catalogs/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .path-card}
### I have metatranscriptomes
**Metatranscriptomics: from counts to functions.** Find out which genes a community expresses and what changes them, without being fooled by changes in who is there. Builds on the gene-catalog lesson, but you can start here.

[Complete]{.status-badge .status-complete}

[About 3 hours · in your browser, nothing to install]{.card-facts}

[Start the lesson →](lessons/metatranscriptomics/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .path-card}
### I have 16S amplicon data
**16S amplicon sequencing: from reads to community types.** Turn amplicon reads into ASVs, deal with contamination in low-biomass samples, and compare communities in a paired study.

[In progress: 2 of 8 parts]{.status-badge .status-progress}

[About 4 hours · in your browser, nothing to install]{.card-facts}

[Start the lesson →](lessons/16s/index.qmd)
:::
